item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that the identified objects qualify as historic or scientific interests needing Antiquities Act protection; the determination occurs in the proclamation itself.","evidence":"I find that each of the objects identified above, and objects of the type identified above within the area described herein, are objects of historic or scientific interest in need of protection"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory predicate findings that the objects face threats, lack adequate protection, and require monument designation and reservation; these findings occur in the proclamation itself.","evidence":"I find that there are threats to the objects identified in this proclamation"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the Antiquities Act determination that the reserved boundaries are the smallest compatible area; the legal predicate is established immediately rather than delegated for later decision.","evidence":"I find that the boundaries of the monument reserved by this proclamation represent the smallest area compatible with the proper care and management of the objects"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President himself presently designates the identified objects as part of the monument and reserves the covered Federal lands, immediately changing their legal status.","evidence":"hereby proclaim the objects identified above that are situated upon lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the Federal Government to be part of the Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monument"},{"segment_id":"5","code":4,"rationale":"The segment combines internal ministerial implementation by the Secretary and Board with a present prohibition against authorizing new rights-of-way, which immediately constrains future land-use approvals.","evidence":"no new rights-of-way shall be authorized within the area reserved by this proclamation"},{"segment_id":"6","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines a mandate that the Secretary later issue a plan producing a specified authorization, discretionary monitoring and agreement evaluation, and a self-executing severability rule.","evidence":"The Secretary shall issue a travel management plan that authorizes motorized and non-motorized mechanized vehicle use"}]}
